findings.problem: A completed request ID accepted changed text and returned an unrelated cached response; beginning its generation also invalidated current media before input validation.
findings.resolution: Parent moved cache/retry/ID preflight before begin and bound cached replies to original user turn.
findings.verification: test_reused_request_id_with_changed_text_rejects_cached_answer passes and original generation remains usable for speech.

findings.problem: A lone Unicode surrogate in public event_id raised UnicodeEncodeError during dedupe hashing.
findings.resolution: Live ingress author added strict UTF-8 validation for IDs, text and actor metadata.
findings.verification: test_unpaired_surrogates_are_rejected_in_all_public_strings passes; next valid event still works.

findings.problem: A very large integer event_at raised OverflowError in math.isfinite.
findings.resolution: Live ingress author handles numeric conversion errors and rejects invalid timestamps.

static_review: Private scope is derived from authenticated local server context; mismatched channel/source/session and claimed permissions are rejected before SSE response or mutations.
Generation and request IDs must jointly match; playback text comes from the committed assistant message. Completion does not prevent explicit media cancellation.
TTS results are checked after synthesis, and deleted/changed assistant history is rechecked before delivery.
Registry and event/dedupe queues have explicit limits; active valid state is not silently evicted to admit other scopes.
Control adapter rejects unsupported tool/cancel actions; it does no networking or execution.
Public event module does not import private application settings, storage, memory, credentials or tools.
Client generation serials and per-Audio cleanup prevent old responses or callbacks from reviving/clearing newer audio.
